title: PBM Services Agreement Onboarding Sheet: Entry Thresholds, Implementation Lead Time and Service Model
content:
Each pricing arrangement of the PBM Services Agreement is open to plan sponsors that meet its entry threshold and funding arrangement, and each fixes the minimum lead time from signing to go-live, the one-time implementation credit per enrolled employee at go-live, and the account management model.

## Entry threshold and funding arrangement

| Pricing arrangement | Entry threshold (minimum covered lives) | Funding arrangements accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 100 | self-funded or fully insured |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 500 | self-funded only |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 250 | self-funded only |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 2500 | self-funded only |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 10000 | self-funded only |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 25000 | self-funded only |

Northbridge Traditional Pricing is the only arrangement open to a fully insured plan.

## Implementation terms and service model

| Pricing arrangement | Minimum lead time, signing to go-live (calendar days) | Implementation credit (USD per enrolled employee, one time at go-live) | Account management model |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 90 | 0.00 | pooled |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 90 | 10.00 | pooled |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 90 | 15.00 | dedicated |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 90 | 15.00 | dedicated |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 120 | 20.00 | dedicated team |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 120 | 25.00 | dedicated team |

## Points of reading

- **Threshold order is not rank order.** Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus opens at 250 covered lives, below the 500 of Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing.
- **Hypothetical size check.** A self-funded sponsor with (hypothetically) 300 covered lives meets the thresholds of Northbridge Traditional Pricing (100) and Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus (250) and of no other arrangement; a fully insured sponsor of any size meets the funding condition of Northbridge Traditional Pricing only.
- **Hypothetical credit reading.** Under an arrangement whose implementation credit is 15.00, (hypothetically) 1000 enrolled employees at go-live correspond to a one-time credit of 15.00 multiplied by 1000, that is 15000.00 USD.
